تغلوا (form I)
# تَغُلُّوا (taḡullū) /ta.ɣul.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# تُغَلُّوا (tuḡallū) /tu.ɣal.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
# تَغِلُّوا (taḡillū) /ta.ɣil.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
